claim: The ANT program's pages have moved from thisisant.com to Garmin's developer site.
quote: Content from thisisant.com has now been moved to Garmin Developer

claim: The ANT+ membership and certification programs, with engineering support, ended on June 30, 2025.
quote: The ANT+ membership program and ANT+ product certification programs, along with associated engineering support ended on June 30, 2025.

claim: ANT+ documentation, device profiles and design tools are available to ANT+ Adopters under the ANT+ Adopter Agreement.
quote: You will enter into this legally binding Agreement and become an ANT+ Adopter and You will have access to the ANT+ Documents, the ANT+ Device Profiles, and the ANT+ Design Tools subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement.

claim: The downloads page still carries an Android ANT+ SDK.

The ANT+ Adopter Agreement was updated on January 3, 2024 to remove certification as a requirement (FAQ, ANT+ Changes; the answers are served in this script bundle of developer.garmin.com/ant-program/faq/).
quote: The ANT+ Adopter Agreement was updated on January 3, 2024 to remove ANT+ Certification as a requirement, and ANT+ Product Certification is no longer offered.

claim: Adopters are responsible for meeting the interoperability requirements with the documentation and design tools.
quote: ANT+ Adopters developing ANT+ products are responsible for meeting the minimum requirements for interoperability by using the ANT+ documentation and ANT+ design tools.

claim: ANT+ has been deprecated and is no longer supported.
quote: ANT+ has been deprecated and is no longer supported.

claim: No new ANT+ device profiles will be introduced.
quote: ANT+ has been deprecated so there will be no new ANT+ profiles.

claim: The ecosystem is transitioning to maintaining existing profiles.
quote: The ecosystem is transitioning to maintaining existing profiles rather than introducing new ones

claim: Existing ANT and ANT+ devices continue to operate as before.
quote: existing ANT and ANT+ devices and products will continue to operate as before, and no changes were made that impact interoperability or functionality of deployed devices.

claim: ANT+ documentation and tools remain accessible under the ANT+ Adopter Agreement.
quote: ANT+ documentation and tools remain accessible here and are subject to the ANT+ Adopter Agreement.

claim: Garmin gives evolving regulatory requirements around security and authentication as the reason.
quote: These programs were discontinued in response to evolving regulatory requirements, particularly around security and authentication

claim: Garmin tells developers to evaluate Bluetooth LE for new feature development.
quote: Developers should continue supporting existing ANT-based products and leverage ANT where appropriate, while evaluating complementary technologies such as Bluetooth LE for new feature development and broader ecosystem integration.

claim: Garmin's FAQ describes the Android route for ANT reception: an ANT USB stick, an OTG cable and two ANT service apps.
quote: Any ANT USB2 stick or newer (such as the ANTUSB-m) can be used with any Android device (phone or tablet) using a USB OTG cable by installing the ANT Radio Service and ANT USB Service from the Google Play Store if the device supports the Android USB Host Mode API.

claim: Garmin's ANT FAQ describes ANT running alongside Bluetooth LE on shared radio infrastructure.
quote: ANT supports multiprotocol operation alongside Bluetooth LE using shared radio infrastructure

claim: Android documents built-in platform support for BLE in the central role.
quote: Android provides built-in platform support for Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) in the central role
